news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Data across 11 equity mutual fund categories reveals that 3-year Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) returns have remained surprisingly subdued compared to shorter and longer timeframes.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail investors blindly believe that any 3-year SIP automatically guarantees double-digit compounding and safety through dollar-cost averaging.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Institutions analyze rolling returns and sequence-of-returns risk: heavy SIP inflows during recent peak valuations severely drag down 36-month XIRR due to expensive unit accumulation.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Stop assessing SIP health using point-to-point XIRR under 5 years; evaluate 5-year rolling returns against benchmark P/E levels before pausing contributions.

slides.title: The Retail Illusion Trap
slides.card_text: Retail investors blindly believe 3-year SIP automatically guarantees double-digit returns and absolute safety through rupee cost averaging.

slides.title: The Hidden Math Reality
slides.card_text: Evaluating performance strictly on a 3-year horizon hides the severe impact of recent peak market valuations and expensive unit buying.

slides.title: Why Compounding Fails Retail
slides.card_text: Heavy SIP inflows during market highs create a sequence-of-returns risk, heavily dragging down your 36-month XIRR and wealth growth.

slides.title: Institutional Mindset Shift
slides.card_text: Institutions never panic over short-term drops. They strictly analyze rolling returns and overall market valuation cycles before making moves.

slides.title: The Golden Protective Rule
slides.card_text: Stop assessing SIP health using point-to-point XIRR under 5 years. Always check benchmark P/E levels before pausing contributions.

slides.title: Pre-Trade Action Checklist
slides.card_text: Review your mutual fund category performance across 1, 3, and 5 years today. Are you ready to audit your portfolio?
